name: OneStream
description: Let agents pull data from the OneStream dashboard data adapters and cube views you choose, and run the data management sequences you allow. For month-end close checks, balance sheet reconciliations and flux, business reviews, and budget and forecast work.
identity: A personal access token of a OneStream user. Agents get exactly that user's access, so use a user made for agents, not an administrator. For OneStream-hosted environments only.

setup.title: Set up a user for agents
setup.body: Personal access tokens work on OneStream-hosted environments set up for OneStream IdentityServer. A token takes on the identity and access of the user who creates it, so sign in as a user made for agents: not in the Administrators group, with access only to the applications, data adapters, cube views and data management sequences agents should use. That user needs the AccessAsNonInteractiveUser security role through a group.

link.label: OneStream: requirements for using personal access tokens

click: System > Administration > Security > Create Group. Name: PATs Users.
Group Membership: Add Users > the agents' user > Save.
System Security Roles > the ellipsis next to AccessAsNonInteractiveUser > PATs Users > OK > Save.

setup.title: Create a personal access token as that user
setup.body: Sign in to OneStream as the agents' user and create the token. OneStream shows it only once.
click: Select the Identity & Access Management Portal icon > Manage Personal Access Tokens.
Create Token. Description: AI agents > CREATE TOKEN > COPY.

setup.title: Find your OneStream addresses
setup.body: Enter the host name of your OneStream environment, such as acme.onestreamcloud.com, and the web server address you sign in at, such as https://acme.onestreamcloud.com/OneStreamWeb. OneStream asks for that address in every request.

fields.label: OneStream host
fields.help: The host name only, such as acme.onestreamcloud.com.

fields.label: Web server address
fields.help: The address of your OneStream web server, such as https://acme.onestreamcloud.com/OneStreamWeb.

capabilities.label: Read data
capabilities.description: Get the rows of a dashboard data adapter or a cube view, such as trial balances, reconciliations, variances or forecast workbooks.
capabilities.note: Changes nothing. Reaches every adapter and cube view the token's user can open, unless you keep a key to chosen ones.

capabilities.label: Run data management sequences
capabilities.description: Run a data management sequence, such as an import, a calculation or a consolidation, and wait for it to finish.
capabilities.note: Sequences can clear, load and recalculate data. Keep each key to chosen sequences.

limits.label: Applications
limits.help: Optional: only these OneStream applications, by name. Leave empty for every application the token's user can open.

limits.label: Data adapters
limits.help: Optional: only these dashboard data adapters, by name.

limits.label: Cube views
limits.help: Optional: only these cube views, by name.

limits.label: Data management sequences
limits.help: Optional: only these data management sequences, by name. Leave empty for every sequence the token's user can run.

revoke: Sign in to OneStream, open the Identity & Access Management Portal > Manage Personal Access Tokens, select REVOKE on the token and confirm. Agents lose access to OneStream at once.

tools.name: onestream_get_adapter_data
tools.description: Get the rows a dashboard data adapter returns, as a table under the name you give it.

table_name.description: Name of the table the rows come back under
table_name.name: ResultDataTableName

variables.description: Values for the adapter's substitution variables, as Name1=[Value1],Name2=[Value2]
variables.name: CustomSubstVarsAsCommaSeparatedPairs

tools.name: onestream_get_cube_view_data
tools.description: Get the rows of a cube view, as a table under the name you give it.

table_per_row.description: One table per cube view row instead of one table
table_per_row.name: DataTablePerCubeViewRow

table_name.description: Name of the table the rows come back under
table_name.name: ResultDataTableName

variables.description: Values for the cube view's substitution variables, as Name1=[Value1],Name2=[Value2]
variables.name: CustomSubstVarsAsCommaSeparatedPairs

tools.name: onestream_run_sequence
tools.description: Run a data management sequence and wait for it to finish; the answer says whether it completed. The wait is at most 30 seconds: a longer sequence keeps running in OneStream, and its outcome is in OneStream's error and activity logs.

variables.description: Values for the sequence's substitution variables, as Name1=[Value1],Name2=[Value2]
variables.name: CustomSubstVarsAsCommaSeparatedPairs
